nodes.label: SuperSplat Viewer
nodes.rationale: Official viewer for SuperSplat; compiles to a simple, self-contained static website. Uses WebGPU by default with automatic fallback, but WebGL must be forced for WebXR/AR/VR.

nodes.label: URL Parameters
nodes.rationale: URL parameters override embedder-supplied asset URLs so an embed stays overridable per instance; the programmatic form (ui:false, reticle:true, etc.) mirrors the flags.

nodes.label: Stochastic Renderer
nodes.rationale: Experimental unsorted, depth-tested splat renderer, WebGPU only (XR included): 'stochastic' for per-pixel quality, 'stochastic=mobile' for phones and headsets; splatSource (direct vs workbuffer) and variant are developer knobs feeding it.
